resources.string: Everything a new user needs in one download: chat, image generation and speech-to-text.
Gemma 4 E2B with vision and MTP speed-up, Stable Diffusion 1.5 (small, fast on phones) and multilingual Whisper Small.
When the Gemma 4 files finish downloading, a managed llama.cpp server with MTP speculative decoding and the vision projector is created automatically. Start it any time from Chat with a model.
